metadata.title: Data Encryption

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for Data and Information Management that protects data confidentiality and integrity through encryption.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Data and information protection technology domain.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Cryptographic protection of institutional data across storage, transmission, and processing contexts.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Encrypted data, cryptographic policy requirements, and protection assertions.

props.name: threat-technique
props.remarks: Access to unencrypted or improperly protected sensitive data.

props.name: defense-technique

metadata.remarks: Data Encryption defines the capability to cryptographically protect institutional data at rest, in transit, and, where applicable, in use. This pattern defines encryption requirements and expectations but does not manage cryptographic keys or certificates. Key lifecycle governance is handled by the key-management pattern.

components.title: Encryption at Rest
components.description: Cryptographic protection of stored data to prevent unauthorized access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Employ cryptographic mechanisms to protect data stored on systems.

components.title: Encryption in Transit
components.description: Cryptographic protection of data as it traverses networks and communication channels.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Protect data in transit from unauthorized disclosure or modification.

components.title: Encryption in Use
components.description: Protection of data while being processed using trusted execution or confidential computing mechanisms.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Protect data during processing where supported by execution environments.

components.title: Algorithm and Strength Requirements
components.description: Definition of approved cryptographic algorithms, key lengths, and modes of operation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Use approved cryptographic algorithms and key strengths to protect data.
